title: Fix false color match in Build Studio chat fallback
body: ## Summary\n\nFixes a bug from [Devin Review on PR #100](https://github.com/letoya-ui/ravlo-platform/pull/100#discussion_r3171341467) where the color detection in the Build Studio chat fallback used simple substring matching, causing false positives:\n- \"blueprint\" triggered \"blue exterior\"\n- \"preferred\" triggered \"red exterior\"\n- \"greenhouse\" triggered \"green exterior\"\n\nNow uses regex word-boundary matching (`\\bblue\\b`) so only standalone color words are detected.\n\n## Review & Testing Checklist for Human\n- [ ] Type \"I have a blueprint for a modern farmhouse\" in Build Studio chat — verify no \"blue exterior\" appears in the response\n\n### Notes\n- One-line fix, low risk Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/0cf31e0cdff749d89fb8a053b73a1979 Requested by: @letoya-ui ---
